# `silk/native_host_input`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Owned native process-input snapshots and per-call working-directory lookup.

## When to use
Capture arguments and environment at a hosted entry, then move the snapshot into a HostInput
provider. Capture copies every byte so later lookups do not depend on foreign input lifetimes.

## Gotchas
Capture is unsafe: input vectors and their NUL-terminated strings must remain readable and
unchanged until it returns. Working-directory lookup observes the process at the time of call.
